reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Trafikinfo SE
reauth_confirm.description: Trafikverket no longer accepts the stored API key. Enter a valid replacement key.

entry_kind.title: Trafikinfo SE
entry_kind.description: Choose whether this entry should track traffic incidents, current road conditions, traffic flow, or travel time for one predefined Trafikverket route.

filter_mode.title: Trafikinfo SE
filter_mode.description: Choose how you want to filter traffic information.

traffic_flow_scope.title: Trafikinfo SE
traffic_flow_scope.description: Choose how you want to find a Trafikverket traffic-flow measurement site.

traffic_flow_coordinate.title: Trafikinfo SE
traffic_flow_coordinate.description: Find traffic-flow measurement sites near a position. The API search is limited to the selected radius.

traffic_flow_county.title: Trafikinfo SE
traffic_flow_county.description: Find traffic-flow measurement sites in one county and sort them by distance from a reference position.

traffic_flow_site.title: Trafikinfo SE
traffic_flow_site.description: Select one measurement site and direction. Nearby lane detectors at the same site are combined.

travel_time_route_scope.title: Trafikinfo SE
travel_time_route_scope.description: Browse Trafikverket's predefined travel time routes. Coverage is currently concentrated in Stockholm, with smaller coverage in Västra Götaland and Skåne.

travel_time_route.title: Trafikinfo SE
travel_time_route.description: Select one predefined Trafikverket route and optionally give the entry a custom name.

configure_coordinate.title: Trafikinfo SE
configure_coordinate.description: Filter traffic information within a radius around a coordinate.

data.name: Name
data.road_filter_safety_bypass: Bypass road filter for safety-related messages

data_description.filter_roads: Separate values with commas or semicolons. Road numbers match exactly; append * for a number prefix (for example, 71*). Road names use case-insensitive text matching.
data_description.road_filter_safety_bypass: If enabled, events marked as safety-related by Trafikverket bypass the road filter and are always shown. 'Viktig trafikinformation' always bypasses the road filter regardless of this setting. Disable to apply road filtering strictly to all event types including Trafikmeddelande.

configure_counties.title: Trafikinfo SE
configure_counties.description: Filter traffic information by one or more counties (or Sweden-wide).

reload_notice.title: Trafikinfo SE
reload_notice.description: Setup is complete. Click submit to finish. After setup, reload the browser page once to make sure the dashboard card is available immediately.

reconfigure_filter_mode.title: Trafikinfo SE
reconfigure_filter_mode.description: Choose how you want to filter traffic information.

reconfigure_traffic_flow_scope.title: Trafikinfo SE
reconfigure_traffic_flow_scope.description: Choose how you want to find a replacement traffic-flow measurement site.

reconfigure_traffic_flow_coordinate.title: Trafikinfo SE
reconfigure_traffic_flow_coordinate.description: Find replacement traffic-flow measurement sites near a position.

reconfigure_traffic_flow_county.title: Trafikinfo SE
reconfigure_traffic_flow_county.description: Find replacement traffic-flow measurement sites in one county.

reconfigure_traffic_flow_site.title: Trafikinfo SE
reconfigure_traffic_flow_site.description: Select a replacement measurement site and direction, and optionally rename the entry.

reconfigure_travel_time_route_scope.title: Trafikinfo SE
reconfigure_travel_time_route_scope.description: Choose which part of Trafikverket's predefined route catalog you want to browse.

reconfigure_travel_time_route.title: Trafikinfo SE
reconfigure_travel_time_route.description: Select a new predefined route and optionally rename the entry.
